notes: Cosm is now extended by packages: ask the agent for something Cosm doesn't do (a page that sums up your notes, keeping the cosm in git) and it builds it, then asks before switching it on; Settings → Packages switches them on and off. Cosm's own layout, its colours and the agent are packages too. Also: bold, links and headings can be edited by their markdown marks, which show as you type in them; clicking below a page puts the cursor at its end; Claude Code's own screen is larger, sharper and in Cosm's colours, and its page links can be clicked; choose the app icon in Settings; a quieter update notice.
